agentConsent.title: Clipy: allow AI agents to record?
agentConsent.body:
A local AI agent (for example Claude Code) is asking Clipy to record your screen.

The normal recording indicator will always be visible, recordings auto-stop at their time limit, and only programs running as your user can ask.

Allow agent-triggered recordings?

Clipy pastes what you said and the recording's AREC path where you were typing, ready for any AI agent that can read files on this Mac, like Claude, Codex or Cursor. sidebar.label: Setup steps
sidebar.footnote: About a minute. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.

welcome.title: Record it once. Everyone can follow it, even your agents.
welcome.body: Record your screen, camera and voice, get a link the moment you stop, and hand the recording to Claude Code or Codex as readable context. Let's get you set up.

signIn.title: Sign in to Clipy
signIn.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser. This window moves on by itself.
signIn.body: Your recordings, links and transcripts live in your Clipy account. We'll open your browser to sign in with Google, then bring you straight back here.

screen.title: Let Clipy see your screen
screen.body: macOS asks for this once. Switch Clipy on under Screen & System Audio Recording. Clipy only captures while you are recording.

accessibility.title: Show where you click
accessibility.body: Accessibility lets Clipy mark your clicks and pointer in the recording, so viewers and agents can follow every step. Switch Clipy on under Accessibility.

permission.stale: macOS lists Screen Recording as allowed but is still blocking capture. Switch Clipy off and back on in {settings}, then restart Clipy.

permission.unanswered: macOS is not answering whether Clipy can see your screen. Restarting Clipy usually sorts this out, and setup picks up where you left off.
permission.switchedOn: Switched it on? macOS applies it after Clipy restarts. Setup picks up where you left off.

media.title: Want to be in your recordings?
media.body: Add your face and voice so people hear the why, not just see the clicks. You can switch either one on or off from the recorder at any time.

camera.title: Camera
camera.detail: A bubble with your face, in any corner.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.detail: Narrate as you go. Transcripts come free.

find.bodyWindows: Click the Clipy icon next to the clock to record. If it is not there, click the <key>^</key> arrow: Windows hides new icons there. Drag Clipy onto the taskbar, or switch it on in Taskbar settings so it always shows.
